# Third-party images mirrored to ghcr.io/thin-edge/tedge-dot/mirror/<name>:<tag> by
# .github/workflows/mirror-images.yaml. CI builds and runs its stacks from the mirror
# (BASE_REGISTRY), so a CI pull never depends on an anonymous, shared-quota registry.
#
# One <name>:<tag> per line, as it appears after `${BASE_REGISTRY}/` in a Dockerfile `FROM`
# or a compose `image:`. `just check-mirrored-images` fails when a referenced image is missing.
alpine:3
debian:bookworm
debian:bookworm-slim
eclipse-mosquitto:2
python:3.11
python:3.11-slim
python:3.11-slim-bookworm
python:3.12-slim
rust:1-bookworm
